# Vendored build inputs

`scripts/fetch-pengu.ps1` checks out Pengu Loader v1.1.6 at commit
`4d641f52bc5d70aac4c09dfa1fa7a043a9069aff`. The checkout and build artifacts
are intentionally gitignored; only the pinning and verification scripts are
committed.

Pengu Loader is MIT licensed. Its original license must be included in any
release that distributes the built loader.
